New e2e suite test_phase5_e2e_owner.py = 6/6 passed. Owner-only Phase 5 routes reject unauthenticated with 401 (/sources/health, GET+PUT /discovery/config, POST /discovery/github/run, POST /opportunities/{id}/recheck). Capability matrix confirmed: LIVE_RECHECK=READY, PERSISTENT_SCHEDULER=PARTIAL, AUTO_ESCALATION=DISABLED, UNATTENDED_EXECUTION=DISABLED, REAL_SOURCE=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, CONTROLLED_OPERATION=READY, DISCOVERY=READY. critical.issue: Default/saved discovery config query is 'label:bounty state:open' which returns GitHub Search HTTP 422 (Unprocessable Entity) when called with an authenticated token. GitHub's Search Issues API rejects the 'state:' qualifier under the Sept 2025 advanced-search enforcement for authenticated calls. Fallback in adapter.fetch() uses the correct form 'is:issue is:open label:bounty', but execution_routes.get_discovery_config (line 193) and discovery_github_run (line 205) still hardcode the invalid default, and the stored system_settings.discovery-config value is also invalid. Discovery endpoint therefore fails with 502 out-of-the-box for any owner, and marks source github as DEGRADED.

minor.issue: Reports 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' even though Phase 5 shipped a real live GitHub adapter (GitHubIssueAdapter with live /search/issues call). Once discovery has succeeded at least once (source_health.status=HEALTHY, total_discovered>0), readiness should reflect REAL_SOURCE=READY (or a graded value). Owner-visible readiness matrix therefore under-reports current capability.

rca of the issue: GitHub deprecated legacy Search Issues qualifiers under authenticated calls (Sept 2025 advanced search rollout). The query 'label:bounty state:open' works unauthenticated but returns HTTP 422 when sent with a bearer token, because 'state:' is no longer accepted; the correct qualifier is 'is:open' combined with 'is:issue'. The adapter's inline fallback in bounty/autonomy.py:286 uses the correct form, but the persisted default in bounty/execution_routes.py:193 and :205 (and the currently saved system_settings.discovery-config) still use the deprecated form, so /discovery/github/run raises HTTPException(502, 'GitHub discovery search HTTP 422') on a fresh install and marks source_health.github as DEGRADED. Mitigation: change the two hard-coded defaults to 'is:issue is:open label:bounty' and add a one-time migration to rewrite invalid stored queries.
